Key points
• Provide a brief overview of the dietary sources of carbohydrates
• Examine the main sources of dietary intake of carbohydrates
• Relate health issues associated with carbohydrate intake
• Summarize studies and evidence on the most important health issues associated with carbohydrate intake
• Discuss the method of carbohydrate restriction for weight management
• Outline the recommendation of various authorities on total carbohydrate, added/free sugar and ﬁber intake
